meta.title: Go Dojo
meta.description: 3564-level Go puzzle campaign (8 chapters) + a boss duel where the board is rendered to a labeled PNG and sent via a vision multimodal API (deepseek-flash etc.; URL/key/model configurable, key stays host-side), falling back to a local greedy AI without a key. Full port of go-game, originally from online-go.com LearningHub.
